description: Add BILLFEE.COLLECTEDBYDOCTORATBILLING (fee collected by the doctor at billing)
issue: #17490 - Inward professional fee collected by the doctor
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
note: BillFee maps a new boolean COLLECTEDBYDOCTORATBILLING, set only by the Collected by Doctor switch on the inward professional fee add page. Run this migration before deploying the build that maps it: every BillFee query names the column. Idempotent; existing rows default to 0.
